description: Personal data is processed without a valid lawful basis as defined in GDPR Article 6. Processing must be justified by consent, contract performance, legal obligation, vital interests, public task, or legitimate interests.
applicability: Applicable to any processing of personal data. Includes data collection, storage, analysis, sharing, and any other operation performed on personal data.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of processing activities, privacy notices, and consent records. Requires mapping each processing activity to a documented lawful basis.
